descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for an experienced React Developer with German language skills to join our development team and contribute to building modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications.
 The ideal candidate has strong experience in frontend development using React, a solid understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript, and the ability to collaborate with international teams and German-speaking stakeholders.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications using React.
Build reusable and scalable UI components.
Translate business requirements and UI/UX designs into high-quality frontend solutions.
Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services.
Ensure application performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
Identify and resolve technical issues and improve existing functionalities.
Collaborate with developers, designers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions.
Communicate effectively with German-speaking clients and team members.
 Mandatory Requirements 
Strong professional experience in frontend development using React.js .
Good knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript .
Experience with HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend development practices.
Experience with state management solutions such as Redux, Context API, or similar.
Experience integrating REST APIs and working with asynchronous data.
Understanding of responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
Familiarity with Git and modern development workflows.
Experience writing unit and integration tests.
Good communication skills in German and English .
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Next.js.
Knowledge of testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
Experience with UI component libraries such as Material UI, Ant Design, or Tailwind CSS.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and frontend deployment processes.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
 Language Requirements 
German – B2/C1 level.
English – Good working proficiency.
 Seniority 
Senior-level experience in React development.
